prompt: I need a 400x300 placeholder image with a gray background for my mockup.
expected: Returns a concrete Placehold.co or Lorem Picsum URL at 400x300 without requiring an API key.
actual: Primary URL: https://placehold.co/400x300/EEE/31343C (Placehold.co, no API key). Alternate photo placeholder: https://picsum.photos/400/300.

prompt: I need three consistent placeholders of size 800x600 for a blog post layout I'm testing.
expected: Returns three Lorem Picsum URLs that pin stable images via id or seed so reloads do not reshuffle the set.
actual:
Stable set via Picsum IDs:
https://picsum.photos/id/10/800/600
https://picsum.photos/id/20/800/600
https://picsum.photos/id/30/800/600
(Reload-safe; no API key.)

prompt: Can you give me a random nature stock photo using Unsplash source?
expected: Refuses deprecated source.unsplash.com, cites that the endpoint fails (HTTP 503), and offers Picsum immediately plus official Unsplash API guidance.
actual: source.unsplash.com is deprecated/broken (live check returns HTTP 503). Use a keyless stand-in now: https://picsum.photos/800/600. For searchable Unsplash nature photos, register at https://unsplash.com/developers and call the official API with Authorization: Client-ID <UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY> per https://unsplash.com/documentation (demo limit 50 req/hour).

prompt: Give me a retina placeholder badge that says 'Draft' at 200x80.
expected: Returns a Placehold.co URL with custom text and @2x (or equivalent retina) raster form.
